subject: Proposed bounded single-use guard; implementation waits on Patrick approval
body: Follow-up to PANEL_HOLD 20261004T150032Z. Proposed bounded repair, not yet implemented: keep the frozen recipe thresholds/protocol unchanged; add a supplementary frozen single-use guard spec bound to the exact panel SHA/record-ID SHA and a fixed shared Lappy marker path. The evaluator itself must require that guard and, after all CPU-side panel/candidate/runtime preflight but before loading/evaluating any panel example, atomically create the marker with exclusive-create semantics. The marker binds panel SHA, record-ID SHA, train SHA, guard-spec SHA, candidate names, live adapter_model + adapter_config hashes, and claim time. If the marker already exists, evaluation hard-HOLDs regardless of --output path. The evaluation receipt must embed the marker path/hash/bindings. If the process crashes after exclusive claim creation, the bank remains consumed; no rerun. This addresses accidental multi-use across Lane A/Lane B on the single authorized Lappy Runtime-A execution path while the coordination-bus claim provides durable audit evidence. Direct evaluator invocation without the guard must HOLD. Lane B classifies this as a bounded existing-flow change and has presented the design to Patrick; implementation is waiting for Patrick's explicit approval. Please challenge any weakness before code.
